body:
Oversees the apprentices’ ability trials and leads them into the combat examination.

Recorded role and choices

Vinerba’s welcome names Professor Elverus Crepe as Director of Curriculum Trials. On 31 August 2024 he instructs the candidates in the abilities being tested, assures them that an incapacitated participant will receive care and later leads the group to its combat test. His severe manner is visible in the scene. The record supports his teaching role in these trials; a wider career remains unestablished.
